--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_with_attribute_mixed_constraints.py
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import pytest
+import pyparsing as pp
+
+
+def test_mixed_constraints_accept_matching_fields():
+    validate = pp.with_attribute(("role", "grid"), id="main")
+    validate("", 0, pp.ParseResults.from_dict({"role": "grid", "id": "main"}))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("attrs", [
+    {"role": "grid"},
+    {"role": "grid", "id": "wrong"},
+    {"id": "main"},
+    {"role": "wrong", "id": "main"},
+])
+def test_mixed_constraints_reject_missing_or_wrong_fields(attrs):
+    validate = pp.with_attribute(("role", "grid"), id="main")
+    with pytest.raises(pp.ParseException):
+        validate("", 0, pp.ParseResults.from_dict(attrs))
+
+
+def test_any_value_still_requires_presence_in_mixed_call():
+    validate = pp.with_attribute(("enabled", pp.with_attribute.ANY_VALUE), id="main")
+    validate("", 0, pp.ParseResults.from_dict({"enabled": "", "id": "main"}))
+    with pytest.raises(pp.ParseException):
+        validate("", 0, pp.ParseResults.from_dict({"id": "main"}))
+
+
+def test_duplicate_names_are_not_overridden():
+    validate = pp.with_attribute(("role", "grid"), role="chart")
+    with pytest.raises(pp.ParseException):
+        validate("", 0, pp.ParseResults.from_dict({"role": "grid"}))
+
+
+def test_mixed_constraints_on_html_start_tag():
+    open_tag, _ = pp.make_html_tags("div")
+    open_tag.add_parse_action(pp.with_attribute(("role", "grid"), id="main"))
+    result = open_tag.parse_string('<div role="grid" id="main">', parse_all=True)
+    assert result.id == "main"
+    with pytest.raises(pp.ParseException):
+        open_tag.parse_string('<div role="grid" id="other">', parse_all=True)
+
+
+def test_positional_failure_is_reported_before_keyword_failure():
+    validate = pp.with_attribute(("role", "grid"), id="main")
+    with pytest.raises(pp.ParseException) as exc:
+        validate("", 0, pp.ParseResults([]))
+    assert "no matching attribute 'role'" in str(exc.value)
spec.notes: The hidden tests exercise both direct validation and the public HTML-tag integration. They do not require any new private API.
